critical_code_review_comments: MasterHomepageAvatar.jsx — single persistent <video>, canplay-gated play(), stall watchdog (9s), and hidden preloader for next scene are all wired correctly. The autoplay attribute is REMOVED at the JSX level (no `autoPlay` prop), and play() is invoked manually only after canplay fires — this is the canonical fix for the iOS/Android mobile 'audio plays, video frozen' race.

useAdaptiveAvatarSrc.js — clean separation: isSlowConnection() short-circuits the HEAD probe, and probeCache prevents re-probing the same /lite/ folder. On 4g/desktop the hook returns mode='full' synchronously and getResolvedSrc is a no-op identity function — verified at runtime (0 /lite/ requests).

HomePage.jsx is 1035 lines — over the 700-line guideline (carried over from Iter 96, not regressed in this iter). Suggest extracting legacy sections (Industries grid, Signal Intelligence, Audiences, Signal Products, Differentiation, Integrations, Demo Selector, CTA strip) to /components/home/legacy/ in a future cleanup pass. Not blocking deployment.

Reorder zone uses `flex flex-col` parent + `order-1 lg:order-2` / `order-2 lg:order-1` classes on direct <section> children. This is the correct Tailwind pattern; verified working at both 390px and 1280px. The child sections set their own width via `relative isolate` chrome so the flex parent doesn't squish them.

rca of the issue: No bug to RCA in this iter. The previously reported avatar lip-sync freeze was addressed by (a) switching to single persistent <video> (no React `key` prop = no remount/decoder teardown on scene change), (b) gating play() on the canplay event so audio and video both have data before playback starts, (c) hidden preloader video for the next scene to warm the cache, and (d) 9s stall watchdog that auto-skips frozen scenes. All four mechanisms verified intact via DOM inspection.
